_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own lander report, recorded by running its report.c (DoDiscoveryReport, MakeReport, ClearReportArea) with util.c's waits (tools/extract/golden/report.c): each drawing call in the screen's coordinates, at the time on the program's clock (UQM's ticks, 840 a second; the waits' SleepThread moves it on, nothing else takes time), with keys going down and up at scripted times, seen as UQM's input sees them (a key held, or one gone down since the last look). The fonts are UQM's default, OPT_PC, as screens.json's: the report area's stamps are frame 21 of graphics.orbitbackground and the text takes its colours from graphics.landerfonteffect. The frames are read from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef).

Each scenario: its text (a lander report of the content, the table and the entry, the first being 0, as UQM's _GetStringData reads it, or a literal of ours), the keys ("d:T" down at T, "u:T" up at T; "stop:T" the recording stopped once the clock passed T, the report waiting for a key), the calls as [time, call], when DoDiscoveryReport put the screen back (restored) and when its WaitForNoInput saw every key up (released), -1 if not.

A call: ["s", resource, frame, x, y] DrawStamp, ["c", x, y, width, height, r, g, b] ClearDrawable (the clip rectangle in the background colour), ["t", font, x, y, align, count, text, r, g, b, effect resource, effect frame] font_DrawText; each with the context's clip rectangle as x, y, width, height. The text is where its pointer is: "{report:N}" the report from byte N of its UTF-8, "{end:N}" MakeReport's end_page_buf (GAME_STRING (end_string) and a newline) from byte N; count characters of it are drawn.
frames: graphics.orbitbackground's number of frames; rects: its frames 18 and 21's GetFrameRect, [x, y, width, height] (the corner less the hot spot, and the size).
